summary: Brera Holdings PLC (d/b/a Solmate Infrastructure) filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff Determination to delist its Class B ordinary shares due to failure to maintain the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days. The company is ineligible for a 180-day compliance period because a prior reverse stock split occurred within the past year. Brera intends to request a hearing before an independent Nasdaq Hearings Panel by April 30, 2026, which will automatically stay any suspension or delisting pending the Panel's decision. The company expects to regain compliance following shareholder approval of a reverse share split received earlier in April. Watch for the Panel's decision and potential further reverse split implementation.
